Original editorial fibre-craft product photography, showing realistic handmade crochet with crisp visible loops, yarn twist, soft stitch relief and subtly irregular artisan contours. Use soft diffused daylight, gentle contact shadows and a pale tactile studio finish. Full-colour autumn earth palette of terracotta, ochre, moss, mulberry, warm cream, oatmeal and stone, with sparing cool accents; premium, cosy, modern adult craft-market mood, uncluttered hierarchy and ample breathing room.
